planCharacteristics.planName: HMSA Akamai Advantage Dual Care (PPO D-SNP)
planCharacteristics.geographicName: Hawaii,Kalawao, Kauai, Maui and Honolulu counties

BenefitUnlimitedComponent.bdBenefitUnlimitedDescription: 2 cleaning services every year, 1 periodontal scaling and root planing service per quadrant every 2 years.
The plan provides 2 fluoride treatments every year, at least three months apart.
The plan provides one set of bitewing X-rays every year. The plan provides one set of full mouth X-rays every 5 years.

Deep Cleaning/Root Planing: 1 per quadrant every 24 months (Up to 4 total for 4 quadrants in mouth). 
Full Mouth Debridement: 1 every 3 calendar years
Therapeutic Cleaning – Gum Inflammation: 2 per calendar year. The 2 cleaning service total is shared with the 16b4 benefit.

Immediate upper complete denture - 1 per lifetime
Immediate lower complete denture - 1 /lifetime
Upper partial/denture - 1  every 5 years
Lower partial/denture - 1 every 5 years
Upper partial/denture adjustments /repairs - 2 per calendar year
Lower partial/denture adjustments /repairs - 2 per year

Extractions (simple & surgical): 4 per calendar year. 
Removal of Impacted Tooth: 1 per tooth per lifetime
